text: Visitors have raised concerns about the quality and flavor of the food served at the library, particularly the salads and venison chili. Two reviews specifically mentioned issues with the taste, describing some dishes as bland or having unbalanced flavors. There was also a comment about the menu range, noting the presence of healthy options but suggesting the recipes need adjustment. Overall, the average rating is low, indicating that food quality is an area needing attention.

windows.60: Recent visitor reviews indicate concerns with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the salads lacking in flavor or the combinations awkward, and one noted the venison chili was bland and needed seasoning. There were also comments about limited menu options and the absence of water cups, which affected perceptions of value and service. Overall, the average rating was low, suggesting that improvements in food quality and service could enhance the visitor experience.
windows.90: Recent visitor reviews indicate ongoing concerns with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the menu limited and some dishes bland or poorly prepared, with specific mentions of salads lacking flavor and certain items not meeting expectations. There were also complaints about the lack of variety and the absence of common sides like chips or fries. A few reviewers noted issues with service, including the refusal to provide cups for water. Overall, while the library itself received positive remarks, the food and dining experience need attention.
